claims.assertion: Swaruu says crop circles can be human hoaxes, spacecraft time-space markers, DNA activators, or extraterrestrial communications.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: Swaruu identifies gravitational-intensity frequencies as the universal interstellar language; she says most races use base-12 mathematics, while other systems communicate only partly.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She frames the mathematical and language claims as her account.

claims.assertion: She says UFO formations encode constellations and spatial regions as contact messages, which some non-speaking civilizations cannot convey in spoken languages.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says the symbols remain undeciphered by humans.
